name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 25 times in 7 visits over 49 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 48 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2025-08-04, at wavelengths from 0.93 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
